title: Concept machine
summary: The object is the explanation: one recognizable machine whose moving parts do what the concept does.
fits: The concept is a mechanism or process with moving parts (queues, caches, filters, scheduling, flows).
The viewer's misunderstanding is about how something works inside, and a physical analogy makes it visible.
A fact-card number or a sim can drive both the motion and the on-screen numbers.
avoid: The topic is a feeling, a habit, a story, a definition, or a history with no inner mechanism.
The real object is already visible and clear; an invented machine would add a layer to decode.
Building the machine costs more model budget than the clarity it adds.
